Guide.GuideTitle: The guide is hosted on Github:

Main.ModeRtsp:
Stream directly to any video player application via RTSP.
Once you enable and apply it open rtsp://{}:6666/ with any video player like mpv or vlc.
This mode doesn't require SwitchCast-Client on your PC.
For network modes it's recommended to use a LAN adapter.
Main.ModeTcp:
Stream to the SwitchCast-Client application via network. This is more stable than the simple network mode.
To setup SwitchCast-Client on your pc refer to the guide on Github
For network modes it's recommended to use a LAN adapter.
Main.ModeUsb:
Use this mode to stream to the SwitchCast-Client application via USB.
To setup SwitchCast-Client on your pc refer to the guide on Github
Main.ModeCast:
Send gameplay video to a Chromecast or Google Cast TV on the same network.
Uses the receiver's built-in native mirroring transport: no hosted receiver or developer app ID.
Video-only; capture and casting start while a compatible game is running.

Patches.Description:
dvr-patches are system patches that allow to stream most incompatible games with SwitchCast, a few games are reported to crash, you can read mone on the issue tracker on https://github.com/exelix11/dvr-patches.
You can also manually download the zip file from the GitHub repo with a computer.
